design_problem_closed.problem: v0.75 heldout blocks are connected components of the validation-radius graph; using that same graph for source continuity makes sources in other heldout components unreachable by construction
design_problem_closed.consequence_if_unfixed: candidate C would be structurally degenerate exactly where spatial transfer is evaluated
design_problem_closed.resolution: validation partition graph and species-conditioned source operator are frozen as distinct response-independent objects

operator.graph: symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor over exact 42 island plot centers
operator.k_rule: smallest integer k >= 1 for which the symmetrized kNN graph over all 42 islands is connected
operator.neighbor_tie_rule: ascending great-circle distance then island ID
operator.kernel_scale_rule: Hyndman-Fan type 7 median of positive edge lengths in the selected graph

required_cross_partition_support.reason: a source graph with zero cross-block edges cannot encode source continuity across the frozen spatial-transfer boundary

source_response_rule.species_universe: exact v0.82 pilot-supported universe; species detected on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands
source_response_rule.pilot_model_training_row: derive occupied sources from all other pilot islands only; defensively exclude the focal island
source_response_rule.confirmatory_prediction_row: derive occupied sources from all frozen pilot islands only

primary_hypothesis_binding.primary_estimand: cluster-weighted mean C-minus-R3 heldout log loss across the full confirmatory spatial-block population
